notes.text: Bite by rodents: Exposure to domestic rodents, squirrel, hare and rabbits do not ordinarily require PEP.
notes.source: NCDC India — National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis (2015)

notes.text: The natural history of rabies in mammals other than dogs and cats is not fully understood and therefore the 10-day observation period is not applicable.
notes.source: NCDC India — National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis (2015)
